newsitem.title: USA: CapStar Hotel Co to acquire two properties.
newsitem.headline: CapStar Hotel Co to acquire two properties.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said on Monday it signed an agreement to purchase the 95-room Georgetown Inn in Washington, D.C. and the Radisson Hotel & Suites in Chicago from Philadelphia-based Amerimar Realty Co.
The Radisson Hotel & Suites is a 40-story, mixed-use hotel and office tower, comprising a 341-room hotel, 93,000 square feet of office space and a 170-space parking facility.
The transaction is expected to close within 30 days, subject to customary documentation and conditions. The company said purchase figures from both deals were not disclosed.
Washington, D.C.-based CapStar owns and manages upscale, full-service hotels throughout the U.S.
